text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The first race of the Triple Tiara, the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fervor at Hanshin Racecourse
was focused entirely upon a single Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: I really want Buena Vista to win the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Of course Buena's gonna win.
In this generation, Buena Vista reigns supreme!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
――……
I knew it…… It really is you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since her Make Debut, Buena Vista
has been steadily gathering more and more fans.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire was gradually beginning to draw attention too,
but on the grand stage of the Classics, the spotlight on Buena Vista was extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
choice_data_list: How are you feeling? A little... nervous?
How are you feeling? A little... nervous?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: No. Right now, my heart is—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I am trembling with sheer joy...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: You heard it, didn't you? The melody of this world's blessings, praising that person—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ah... I cannot help but feel exhilarated.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "At the fact that such a beloved 'absolute heroine' is the trial I must overcome—!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The moment she is overcome, the radiance is perfected,
the Saint's vessel is filled, and the gates shall open—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
And so, I shall become it.
A truly radiant saint, Red Desire.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Blessedly, the entire racetrack has united as one, striving to bring the tale of Saint Red Desire to its completion.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: O wise Trainer, please watch over this saint as she runs forward without hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is no cloud in her eyes.
She wholeheartedly welcomes even the atmosphere of Buena Vista's total dominance as fuel for herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The noble, proud saint, Red Desire.
I want to be the one who believes in her victory above all else.
choice_data_list: We are definitely going to overcome this trial!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes...! Saint Red Desire swears to do her utmost and seize the radiance!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Looking forward to today, Desire-chan.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Our journey on the path to the Triple Tiara
is finally getting underway, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes, Buena. Many people are watching to see how this destiny unfolds.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Look... I can even hear it all the way over here.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A blessing upon the heroines
racing across the turf—...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the cheers really are incredible.
Hehe... It's making my heart race.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is cheering so hard for me...
I definitely want to live up to their passionate feelings!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes... you are someone who runs
for the sake of others, to live up to their expectations.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... a demeanor truly befitting
a beloved child of this world.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —An existence completely different from my own.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I have only one purpose:
to run for my own destiny."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"All I need to do is keep moving these legs
to reach that distant 'Otherworld.'"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
For that sake—I must defeat you
in the Triple Tiara campaign!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Please, accompany me.
Until the very moment this world is repainted anew.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: An alternate world...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Yeah. There really is something you want from the bottom of your heart, isn't there, Desire-chan?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
But you know, I'm the same.
There's something I want to win and seize for myself.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: That's why I won't lose. I can never afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Desire-chan.
Let's both make this the best race ever!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I promise you a sublime run.
—And then.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"By defeating you,
I shall reach another realm—!"
